page_title: TablePro: native database client for Mac, iPhone and iPad

summary.name: TablePro
summary.one_liner: TablePro is a native, open-source database client for macOS, iPhone and iPad that lets you run queries and browse and edit data across many databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, MongoDB and Redis.
use_cases: browse and edit tables in PostgreSQL or MySQL
write and review SQL queries with autocomplete
compare and sync schemas between databases
import CSV or Excel files into tables
connect to remote servers over SSH tunnels
let an AI coding client query saved connections via MCP
summary.what_it_does: TablePro provides a SQL editor with schema-aware autocomplete, saved and searchable query history, and row edits that wait until you save, with SQL review before applying. It supports import of CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, XLSX and SQL files, and export to CSV, JSON, SQL, XLSX, Markdown, HTML and XML. Connections can use SSH tunnels, TLS or supported cloud sign-in, and per-connection Safe Mode levels guard against accidental writes. On the Mac, an optional AI assistant works with providers you choose (including local models), and a built-in MCP server lets clients such as Claude Desktop and Cursor query saved connections in read-only mode by default.
notable: Native interfaces, not Electron or a Java runtime
Open source under AGPLv3, including paid-feature code
Per-connection Safe Mode levels with Touch ID or password gating on Mac
Built-in MCP server listening on 127.0.0.1, off by default and read-only at start
caveats: Compare & Sync, Query Insights, Data Rewind and iCloud Sync require the paid Starter tier on the Mac; Team adds Team Catalog and Team Library
Mac app supports 37 databases; iPhone and iPad support a smaller set of engines
AI assistant is available on the Mac only and your AI provider may charge for use
Importing connections from other apps and Open Project Folder are Mac-only features
